text.tspan: Two different answers to one question: which item comes out next?
Your browser's Back button. The page you
visited most recently is the one you return to first.
The print queue, or the line at the deli counter.
Waiting longest means being served first.
A stack reverses the order things arrived in. A queue preserves it.
Choosing the wrong one is a real bug: undo that undoes the wrong thing, or a support queue that answers the newest ticket first.
